column3: sign of the measure of dissolution
whose delusion is shaken off by the knowledge arisen
removing the dust and darkness of the self
this mass of unrighteousness is increasing
though awakened by histories, did not awake
when he went forth as a renunciate
eighth chapter named the rule of questions
shining with a gracious smile and reddish eyes
beds, seats and food heaved with the rush of joy
in the north they brought the lost
with hair standing on end with joy
with humble salutations, embraces, touching hands, smiles and glances
this belonging to the previous kalpa
out of desire to save life
having seen the peril of life
who had made their morning offerings in the fires
the heavenly river, in the fast
seated for the fast unto death
when seated for the fast unto death
seated for the fast unto death
in the lineage of the beloved
with eyes opened wide with joy
with love, shyness, smile and glances
with hair thrilled by excess of love and greatly joyful
with loving looks, charming smiles and sweet talk
with all syllables of speech choked by love
with fruit, flowers, unbroken rice and sprouts
in the form of the fruit
in the form of the fruit of hearing
worship of the Lord with fruits
worships this by devotion and yoga
taking refuge in the lotus feet of the Lord
of the company of those who associate with the Lord
in the form of worship of the Lord
remembering by the power of the wish to worship the Lord
the power of those who rely on the Lord
in chanting the Lord's names and so on
enhanced by the glory of the Lord
the Lord Ananta, ocean of endless qualities
the Lord took away the burden
the Lord, the protector of dharma
free from fear from anywhere, all good
fear by day and night and so on
having heard the sound of the burden
and your satisfaction of the Self
the chief among Shiva and Brahma
the end of the flow of worldly life
of the disease of worldly existence
bondage and liberation of worldly existence
the boat across the ocean of worldly life
you are not with better or equals
of the hearing of the Bhagavata
with the wish to take away the burden
the Bhargava came, his mount tired
in the armies of Bhishma, Karna, the teacher and Shalya, the great (not small)
what Bhishma said and what Achyuta said
description of the sphere of the world
on earth and in the sky
of the one who hurts beings
the most wicked who hurts beings
on earth beings keep falling in this
having become, he made one endowed with peace of self
of the circle of the earth
(they) worshipped with ever-growing love in joy
afflicted with the sole thought of enjoyment
Bhojas, Dasharhas, Arhas, Satvatas, Andhakas and Vrishnis
at the end of the meal
neck adorned with the shining Kaustubha jewel
in the form of a brother
shown the way by his brother
by a mere play of the brows
skilled in the secret love-spells of the circle of brows
he, self-ruled, cast aside hundred akshauhinis
by the obstruction of the swarm of bees
by the Madhus, Bhojas, Dasharhas, Arhas, Kukuras, Andhakas and Vrishnis
desiring to cross the ocean with the lamp of the Self
by those delighting mind and senses
moon of the mind (the mind, moon)
with gait, sport, shyness and modesty that milk the minds and eyes of men to joy
by the king of the demon dynasty, my great burden
one who took refuge in me
by me alone both are declared
in me, a child whose every fickleness is gone
of one who has offered the self to me
in me, my son, who has no other refuge
the name of the greatest of the great
whose nature is to be favoured by the greatest
by Mahat (the great principle) and so on, in the Self
half the seat of the great
food offered to the Lord (mahaprasada) and so on
the blessed one making his hermitage a holy place
I knew the power of maya
having maya as a limiting condition
the sages are sparing of speech
having the nature of a sage
the kinsmen killed by sages, given to grief
rushed to take what was dead
about to sacrifice with the horse sacrifice
